timeline.title: Public concern emerges
timeline.short_description: Reported patient experiences prompted scrutiny; the dossier preserves those experiences as anonymized cohort evidence.

timeline.title: External review conducted
timeline.short_description: The commissioned review interviewed seven women and nine health providers.

timeline.title: Report issues ten Calls to Action
timeline.short_description: The report documented themes of profiling, powerlessness and coercion and recommended structural reforms.
timeline.organization: External reviewers Yvonne Boyer and Judith Bartlett

timeline.title: Health-region apology reported
timeline.short_description: The health region publicly apologized after release of the review.

timeline.title: Proposed class proceeding develops
timeline.short_description: Litigation proceeded through pleadings and interlocutory questions, including a 2024 intervention decision.
timeline.organization: Court of King's Bench for Saskatchewan

timeline.title: House health committee reports
timeline.short_description: The federal committee reviewed coerced sterilization evidence and made federal recommendations.
timeline.organization: House of Commons Standing Committee on Health

timeline.title: Indigenous Birth Support Worker Program begins
timeline.short_description: SHA identifies the program as a response to the 2017 report.

timeline.title: Program evaluation documents use
timeline.short_description: The evaluation reports operational learning and recommendations for continuation and scale.

timeline.title: Class certification dismissed
timeline.short_description: The court dismissed certification; the procedural decision did not decide the truth of each alleged sterilization claim.
timeline.organization: Court of King's Bench for Saskatchewan

timeline.title: Bill S-228 receives royal assent
timeline.short_description: Federal Criminal Code clarification is later contextual legal development and is not treated as a retroactive case remedy.
